title: Olivia and the Quiet Fire
subtitle: Heat is a tiny dance
author: Olivia's Shelf
blurb: Olivia holds a sun-warm stone and learns that heat is tiny bits dancing — faster when things feel warm.

magic.launch: The little rocket pushed the air, and the air pushed back.
magic.drop: Everything falls. That pull has a name: gravity.

openai.instructions: Warm, clear storyteller reading a science picture book to a child. Curious, never lecturing. Pause at full stops.

pages.heading: A quiet fire
pages.text: {Olivia} held a sun-warm {stone} on the {workshop} bench. "{Elon:elon/look}," she said. "It feels like a quiet fire."

pages.heading: Tiny bits dancing
pages.text: "{Heat} is tiny bits {dancing}," said {Elon:elon/teach}. "A faster dance feels warmer. A slower dance feels cooler."

pages.heading: Heat likes to share
pages.text: Olivia poured warm water into cold. Soon they felt the {same}. "Heat likes to {share}," said Elon. "It flows from warm to cool."

pages.heading: Melt and steam
pages.text: An ice cube {melted} in her palm. Steam lifted from the kettle. "Same water," said Elon. "The dance got fast enough to {fly}."

pages.heading: The Sun is a giant fire
pages.text: They looked at the {Sun:stars/glow}. "Its dance travels here as {light}," said {Elon:elon/teach}. "Then the stone feels warm."

pages.heading: Keep asking why
pages.text: "Why do rubbing hands get warm?" asked {Olivia:olivia/ask}. "You are making the tiny bits dance," said {Elon:elon/teach}. "Ask why again tomorrow."

end.heading: The End
end.text: Heat is a tiny dance. Faster feels warm. Heat likes to share.
end.prompt: What would you warm with your hands tomorrow?

credits: Painted for Olivia's Shelf. Elon is a picture-book inventor who teaches physics; this is not a biography.

questions.wrong: Elon said heat is tiny bits dancing.

questions.q: Which way does heat like to flow?
questions.right: That's right. Heat shares itself toward cooler things.
questions.wrong: Heat flows from warm to cool.
